walkthrough:
In isosceles triangle $\triangle ABC$ ($AB = AC = 8\text{ cm}$ and $\angle CAB = \frac{2\pi}{7}$ radians):
$$\angle ABC = \frac{\pi - \frac{2\pi}{7}}{2} = \frac{\frac{5\pi}{7}}{2} = \frac{5\pi}{14}\text{ radians}$$

Because $ABD$ is a straight line, angles on a straight line sum to $\pi$ radians:
$$\angle CBD = \pi - \angle ABC = \pi - \frac{5\pi}{14} = \frac{9\pi}{14}\text{ radians}$$

Calculate the base length $BC = BD$ in isosceles triangle $\triangle ABC$ using trigonometry:
$$BC = 2 \times 8\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{7}\right) \approx 16(0.433884) \approx 6.9421\text{ cm}$$
$$BD = BC \approx 6.9421\text{ cm}$$

Calculate circular arc $CD$ (centred at $B$ with radius $BC \approx 6.9421\text{ cm}$ and angle $\angle CBD = \frac{9\pi}{14}$ radians):
$$\text{Arc } CD = r_B\theta_B = 6.9421 \times \frac{9\pi}{14} \approx 14.0205\text{ cm}$$

Calculate circular arc $CB$ (centred at $A$ with radius $AB = 8\text{ cm}$ and angle $\angle CAB = \frac{2\pi}{7}$ radians):
$$\text{Arc } CB = r_A\theta_A = 8 \times \frac{2\pi}{7} = \frac{16\pi}{7} \approx 7.1808\text{ cm}$$

Sum the boundary lengths to find the total perimeter of the shaded region:
$$\text{Perimeter} = BD + \text{Arc } CD + \text{Arc } CB = 6.9421 + 14.0205 + 7.1808 = 28.1434 \approx 28.1\text{ cm} \quad (\text{to 3 s.f.})$$
